svg.aria-description: Parcelpoint's label and event services, from an ARM template: 5 nodes, 4 connections. 8 resources on Azure, nested in the groups, networks, and subnets that hold them, imported from ARM. svg.title: Parcelpoint's label and event services, from an ARM template
svg.desc: Parcelpoint's label and event services, from an ARM template: 5 nodes, 4 connections. 8 resources on Azure, nested in the groups, networks, and subnets that hold them, imported from ARM. An arrow means one resource refers to another, and its label says how: a role, a private link, logs, or a secret. Nodes: - Account: Azure subscription - Resource group: Resource group - Group: stparcelprodlabels - Storage account, storage - labels (Blob container), storage - Group: sb-parcel-prod - Service Bus namespace (Standard), queue - carrier-events (Service Bus queue), queue - Service plan: asp-parcel-prod-events (Y1) - func-parcel-prod-events (Function app), function Connections: - func-parcel-prod-events to Storage account: Storage Blob Data Contributor, storage - func-parcel-prod-events to Service Bus namespace: Azure Service Bus Data Receiver, messages - labels to Storage account: part of - carrier-events to Service Bus namespace: part of

g.text: Azure Service Bus Data Receiver, messages
